## Protocol

- `sessions.pin` — `PUT /api/sessions/{id}/pin`
- `sessions.order` — `PUT /api/sessions/order`

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/actions-bulk-stop-remove-are-daemon-batches` — Bulk Stop and Remove are daemon batches over a list of ids, each under its per-session lock, reporting done, skipped and failed; the dashboard never loops. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: actions, rail) → `docs/adr/actions-bulk-stop-remove-are-daemon-batches.md`
- `kb:adr/connection-absent-vs-null-json-fields-decode-as-raw-message` — A request field whose absence and null mean different things decodes as a non-pointer json.RawMessage, because a pointer cannot tell the two apart. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, launch) → `docs/adr/connection-absent-vs-null-json-fields-decode-as-raw-message.md`
- `kb:adr/drop-reorder-drag-mime-custom-type` — Internal tile and rail reorder drags carry a Muster-specific MIME type instead of text/plain, so a dragover can tell a reorder from dragged text. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: drop, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/drop-reorder-drag-mime-custom-type.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-group-control-hides-below-640px-container-width` — The Focus header's group control hides by a container query at 640px of the header's own width; the title floor stays 6rem, not the mockup's 22ch. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: focus, rail) → `docs/adr/focus-group-control-hides-below-640px-container-width.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-rail-click-focuses-terminal` — A pointer click on a rail card puts keyboard focus in that session's terminal; keyboard activation, number chords and the Tiles strip only select. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: focus, rail, surfaces) → `docs/adr/focus-rail-click-focuses-terminal.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-rail-plus-one-live-pane` — The Focus view is a rail of static cards beside exactly one live pane, with account usage in a persistent masthead. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: focus, rail, usage) → `docs/adr/focus-rail-plus-one-live-pane.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-repo-block-keeps-floor-beside-group-control` — Beside the group control the Focus header's repo block keeps its 8-character floor and never hides; the title gives way first, so a long folder may ellipsize. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: focus, rail) → `docs/adr/focus-repo-block-keeps-floor-beside-group-control.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-bypass-offered-with-danger-guardrails` — Start in offers bypass as a danger segment with a warning line and a danger Launch without checks button; a bypass chip marks the session wherever it shows. (accepted, 2026-09-28; features: launch, rail, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/launch-bypass-offered-with-danger-guardrails.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-bypass-warning-surfaced-never-answered` — Claude Code's bypass warning is surfaced from absence of signal, like the trust prompt, and never answered by Muster. (accepted, 2026-09-28; features: launch, rail) → `docs/adr/launch-bypass-warning-surfaced-never-answered.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-new-group-created-with-the-row-or-not-at-all` — A launch naming a new group inserts the group row right before the session row and the rollback deletes it, so a failed launch creates neither. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: launch, rail) → `docs/adr/launch-new-group-created-with-the-row-or-not-at-all.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-new-session-button-in-masthead` — One New session button sits in the masthead beside the view switcher, visible in both views; the rail head and the Tiles toolbar lose theirs. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: launch, views, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/launch-new-session-button-in-masthead.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-background-tasks-count-not-state` — The latest Stop's running background tasks become a count on the Session; the state stays idle and the card shows a neutral line. (accepted, 2026-10-01; features: lifecycle, rail) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-background-tasks-count-not-state.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-card-shows-launch-directory-marks-claude-elsewhere` — The card, shell, docs reader and file drop stay on the launch directory; a secondary ↳ readout shows where Claude is only while in another checkout. (accepted, 2026-10-01; features: lifecycle, rail, focus, tiles, card-location) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-card-shows-launch-directory-marks-claude-elsewhere.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-activity-line-turn-aware-default-with-pref` — The activity line is turn-aware by default — your prompt while a turn is open, Claude's reply once it closes — with a pref for prompt, reply or both. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: rail, settings, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/rail-activity-line-turn-aware-default-with-pref.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-attention-order-your-turn-before-active` — Attention order puts every state that waits on the user first — needs input, failed, unread idle, started — then planning and working, then read idle last. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: rail, shortcuts, tiles) → `docs/adr/rail-attention-order-your-turn-before-active.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-card-title-foreground-token` — A card title renders in the foreground token on every surface, so the read-idle drop to muted is a real drop in the rail as it already was in the strip. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: rail) → `docs/adr/rail-card-title-foreground-token.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-card-title-leads-and-density-ramp-corrected` — The rail card leads with its wrapping title and puts the state row beneath it; the density ramp grows monotonically from compact to expanded. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: rail, settings) → `docs/adr/rail-card-title-leads-and-density-ramp-corrected.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-current-marker-means-shown-in-focus` — The rail marks the session the Focus pane shows with a neutral treatment and aria-current; it never means live in this view, so Tiles renders none. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: rail, focus) → `docs/adr/rail-current-marker-means-shown-in-focus.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-filter-and-selection-are-window-state` — The rail's All · Groups · Ungrouped filter and the select-mode selection are per-window client state, never a preference; the filter resets to All on reload. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-filter-and-selection-are-window-state.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-group-name-click-does-not-fold` — A click on a renameable group's name does not fold its section, so a double-click can rename it; the rest of the header still folds. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-group-name-click-does-not-fold.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-groups-daemon-rows-whole-list-broadcast` — Rail groups are daemon rows broadcast whole as one groups message on every change; membership is a per-session groupId riding the session upsert. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, lifecycle, connection, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-groups-daemon-rows-whole-list-broadcast.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-launch-leaves-rail-scroll-untouched` — A launch leaves the rail's scroll alone, as the number chords do, so the current marker may sit on an off-screen card in an overflowing rail. (accepted, 2026-09-23; features: launch, rail, focus) → `docs/adr/rail-launch-leaves-rail-scroll-untouched.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-live-card-offers-no-actions` — A live rail or strip card offers no action button; End stays in the Focus mainhead and tile footers and returns to the card via a right-click menu. (accepted, 2026-10-01; features: rail, actions) → `docs/adr/rail-live-card-offers-no-actions.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-new-group-is-named-before-it-exists` — The rail's inline new-group editor is a client-pending section; nothing is sent until Enter with a non-empty name, so the daemon never holds an unnamed group. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-new-group-is-named-before-it-exists.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-order-daemon-owned-per-session-fields` — Rail order and pinned state are daemon-owned per-session fields with daemon-held invariants; the daemon persists and broadcasts, the client sorts. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: rail, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/rail-order-daemon-owned-per-session-fields.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-pin-invariant-scoped-per-section` — Pinned-before-unpinned holds within each section; railPos stays unique over all sessions, and a section's rebuild reuses the values it already holds. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, lifecycle, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-pin-invariant-scoped-per-section.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-repo-line-wraps-at-slash` — The repo readout wraps at the slash, folder over branch, each line truncated with a hover; compact and tile headers stay one line; the model never truncates. (accepted, 2026-10-01; features: rail, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/rail-repo-line-wraps-at-slash.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-section-headers-drag-in-both-sort-modes` — Section headers drag to reorder sections in both sort modes because section order is user-owned in both; cards keep dragging in manual mode only. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-section-headers-drag-in-both-sort-modes.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-select-mode-disables-card-drag` — While select mode is on, rail cards are not draggable and the pin control is hidden; moves go through the selection bar. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-select-mode-disables-card-drag.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-select-mode-persists-across-bar-actions` — Move to, Ungroup, Stop and Remove from the selection bar leave select mode and the selection on; only Done, Escape, Tiles or an empty rail end it. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, actions, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-select-mode-persists-across-bar-actions.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-summary-dot-order-is-attention-order-idle-once` — A section header's summary lists states in attention order with idle counted once, after working, and ended members last under a neutral dot. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-summary-dot-order-is-attention-order-idle-once.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-ungrouped-is-section-zero-on-the-wire` — Group endpoints address the Ungrouped section as id 0; a session with no group has groupId null; Ungrouped's place and collapsed flag persist in kv. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, lifecycle, groups) → `docs/adr/rail-ungrouped-is-section-zero-on-the-wire.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-unread-inferred-from-live-terminal-client` — A session is unread when its turn closed while no terminal client was attached; the daemon infers it from its terminal registry and clears it on attach. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: rail, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/rail-unread-inferred-from-live-terminal-client.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-unread-marker-neutral-dot` — An unread idle card shows a neutral dot before its title and a read idle title drops to muted; no word, no state colour. (accepted, 2026-09-22; features: rail) → `docs/adr/rail-unread-marker-neutral-dot.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-user-owned-manual-order-default` — The rail has two sort modes: manual, the default, keeps a user-owned pinned-then-positional order; attention is the old needs-input-first sort, kept as a mode. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: rail, settings) → `docs/adr/rail-user-owned-manual-order-default.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-whole-card-drag-drop-decides-pin` — Rail cards drag by the whole card with insert-and-shift semantics; the drop position decides pin state, and a pin control lifts a card into the pinned block. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: rail) → `docs/adr/rail-whole-card-drag-drop-decides-pin.md`
- `kb:adr/shortcuts-cmd-n-follows-rail-order` — The number chords select the nth card in the order the rail currently displays, manual or attention, rather than staying attention-ranked. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: shortcuts, rail) → `docs/adr/shortcuts-cmd-n-follows-rail-order.md`
- `kb:adr/shortcuts-jump-to-neediest-option-command-zero` — Option-Command-0 selects the neediest session by attention priority, ignoring the rail's sort mode and pinned block; no live session is a silent no-op. (accepted, 2026-09-04; features: shortcuts, rail) → `docs/adr/shortcuts-jump-to-neediest-option-command-zero.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-attach-target` — The one-live-client law is per attach target, not per session: a session's Claude socket and shell socket coexist and never supersede each other. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-attach-target.md`
- `kb:adr/web-batch-result-type-lives-in-protocol` — The daemon's batch result shape (done, skipped, failed) is decoded in protocol/batch.ts, shared by api/sessions.ts and api/groups.ts. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: actions, rail) → `docs/adr/web-batch-result-type-lives-in-protocol.md`
- `kb:adr/web-menu-component-single-builder` — One menu builder serves every dashboard menu — rail ⋯, header ⋯, Move to and the Focus-header control — and the design system gains a Menu component. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rail, focus, actions, groups) → `docs/adr/web-menu-component-single-builder.md`

- `kb:adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows` — End, Resume and Remove live in a mainhead above the focused terminal and in hover-revealed action rows on rail cards and tile footers, behind confirm dialogs. (superseded, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows.md`
- `kb:adr/nongoal-attention-ribbon-post-v1` — The attention ribbon, a timeline of session events, is not built in v1; the event table already carries what it would need. (rejected, 2026-08-16; features: rail) → `docs/adr/nongoal-attention-ribbon-post-v1.md`
- `kb:adr/nongoal-macos-notifications` — No macOS notifications or other alerts outside the dashboard; the dashboard is the alert surface by design. (rejected, 2026-08-16; features: rail) → `docs/adr/nongoal-macos-notifications.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-attention-sort-order` — The rail sorts by attention: Needs-Input longest-blocked first, then Failed, Planning, Working, Started, Idle longest-idle first. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: rail) → `docs/adr/rail-attention-sort-order.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-card-state-row-then-wrapping-title` — The rail card leads with a small state row and lets the title wrap; a three-step density pref in the rail head trades rows for cards. (superseded, 2026-09-22; features: rail, settings) → `docs/adr/rail-card-state-row-then-wrapping-title.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-session` — A session is live on exactly one surface at one geometry at a time; every other rendering of it is a static snapshot. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-session.md`
